measurement_rules.condition: Exterior wall with no shared common area beyond it
measurement_rules.description: Measure to interior face of exterior wall. No additional offset.

measurement_rules.condition: Exterior wall with adjacent common area (e.g., shared corridor outside)
measurement_rules.description: If shared wall to common area, measure to interior face of shared wall but not more than 200mm into bounding wall thickness.
measurement_rules.note: DXF must distinguish shared walls; 200mm limit governs offset

measurement_rules.condition: Double-wall condition (cavity or insulation between two facings)
measurement_rules.description: For double-wall construction, measure to centerline of the cavity between the two wall faces.
measurement_rules.note: DXF must show both wall facings or explicitly label cavity width for centerline calculation

measurement_rules.description: Curtain wall thickness is not added to area. Measure to interior face of curtain wall frame or structure behind it.
measurement_rules.note: DXF must differentiate curtain wall from structural wall

measurement_rules.condition: Non-structural projection (balcony, canopy, overhang) on exterior wall
measurement_rules.description: For GFA: non-structural projections are excluded (measure to interior face only). For GLA: projections may be included if directly adjacent to tenant space.
measurement_rules.note: Must explicitly flag non-structural vs. structural projections in DXF. GFA excludes them; GLA treatment depends on tenant adjacency.

measurement_rules.condition: Structural projection (pilaster, fin, etc.) on exterior wall
measurement_rules.description: Structural projections are included in area. Measure to outer face of projection.
measurement_rules.note: DXF must differentiate structural vs. non-structural

measurement_rules.condition: Internal wall shared between two enclosed spaces (GLA/FOH/BOH/ISA)
measurement_rules.description: Measure each space to the interior face of the shared wall. Wall is not double-counted; each space counts its side only.
measurement_rules.note: Wall line in DXF must be explicitly drawn as shared boundary, not duplicated

measurement_rules.condition: Internal wall thickness where both faces are part of measured area
measurement_rules.description: If both sides of an internal wall are leasable or included (e.g., two tenant spaces separated by shared wall), measure both to centerline of wall.
measurement_rules.note: Applies only to GLA calculation; interior public/staff areas use interior-face rule

measurement_rules.description: Glazing thickness is negligible and not added to area. Measure to inner edge of frame.

void_measurement_rules.void_type: Shaft serving single tenant (lift, stair, vent exclusive to one leasable space)
void_measurement_rules.description: Voids/shafts inside or serving a tenant are measured to the interior face of their bounding walls. If wall is shared with common area beyond, interior-face offset is capped at 200mm into the shared wall.
void_measurement_rules.note: This void boundary is counted as part of the tenant's GLA

void_measurement_rules.void_type: Shaft for building-wide GFA aggregation (multi-story lift, central vent)
void_measurement_rules.description: When counting void spaces for GFA calculations, use centerline of bounding walls. This prevents double-counting when the same shaft appears on multiple floors.
void_measurement_rules.note: This void boundary is NOT double-counted across floors; centerline method ensures single-instance area for entire shaft

void_measurement_rules.void_type: Shaft serving multiple tenants or mixed public/private use
void_measurement_rules.description: If void serves multiple tenants, treat as GFA-aggregation method (centerline). Alternative: if each tenant's portion is separately bounded, each tenant can use interior-face method for their exclusive portion.
void_measurement_rules.flag: Ambiguity between §4.4 (p.59, interior-face) and Figure 4.59 (p.68, centerline). Recommend confirming with SEVEN before production use.
void_measurement_rules.interim_decision: Default to centerline for multi-tenant voids; allow DXF label override to use interior-face if explicitly marked VOID_SINGLE_TENANT

void_measurement_rules.void_type: Void or cavity within external building envelope (air gaps, insulation cavities)
void_measurement_rules.description: External building envelope voids (not serving an internal function) are not counted in any area survey.
void_measurement_rules.note: Examples: curtain wall cavities, facade insulation spaces

wall_classification_rules.description: Permanent structural enclosure of building. Load-bearing to building frame.
Cladding, infill, or curtain wall not part of primary structure.
Separates two enclosed spaces (tenants, zones, uses). Fire-rated.
Non-load-bearing partition within a single use area.
Vertical structural element. If protruding into measured space, thickness included.
